content.short: evmdasm is an Ethereum EVM bytecode registry, disassembler, and code manipulation library.
content.description: evmdasm is a lightweight library for Ethereum EVM bytecode, offering an instruction registry, a disassembler, and tools for EVM code manipulation. Developers can use it to locate a static interface and registry for EVM opcodes and instructions, facilitating reference and exploration of bytecode. The project is open-source and actively maintained on GitHub, which provides usage instructions and a community of contributors who collaborate on its development.
